items.title: Tying a Ribbon Around a Book Gift
items.alt: Hands in plum sleeves tie a red, black and green ribbon around a wrapped book on a woven mat, with gold scissors beside it.
items.description: A bow forms over a cream-wrapped book, whose page edges remain visible beneath the paper. Plum knitted cuffs and a pair of gold scissors frame this close view of gift wrapping.

items.title: Kwanzaa Meal Table
items.alt: An oval wooden table holds bowls of rice, greens and beans, cornbread and vegetables over a red, black and green runner.
items.description: Bowls and serving platters fill an oval table supported by turned wooden legs. A striped runner passes beneath the food, and a carved goblet stands near the cornbread.

items.title: Preparing Greens Together
items.alt: Two cooks prepare a shared meal at a wooden kitchen unit, one stirring a red pot while the other holds a bowl of greens.
items.description: A cook in a teal apron stirs a red pot while a second cook in a rust blouse tears greens into a wooden bowl. Vegetable baskets and a closed pot occupy the shelves below their worktop.

items.title: Leafy Greens with a Wooden Serving Spoon
items.alt: A cream ceramic bowl of leafy greens and small vegetable pieces rests on a striped cloth, with a wooden spoon across the rim.
items.description: Dark folded greens fill a softly rounded cream bowl, dotted with red and pale vegetable pieces. A wooden spoon stretches across the rim above the red, black and green cloth.

items.title: Black-Eyed Peas and Cornbread
items.alt: A blue pottery bowl of black-eyed peas sits beside a golden cornbread square on a wooden board and striped cloth.
items.description: Small pale beans with dark markings fill a blue pottery bowl. A thick square of golden cornbread sits alongside it on a wooden serving board, with striped fabric beneath.

items.title: Plate and Corn on a Woven Place Mat
items.alt: An overhead place setting includes a cream plate, wooden utensils, a carved cup, folded striped cloth and an ear of corn.
items.description: A cream plate anchors this overhead arrangement on a round woven mat. Wooden cutlery, a carved cup and folded red, black and green fabric surround it, with dried corn at the edge.
